items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I don't think he got Nick right away. I think Nick went to China, or he went somewhere.

ctx.x: all the rest of them.. But I don't think he got Nick right away. I think Nick went to China, or he went somewhere.

Anyway, Russell got his band together... I think this is when Higgenbotham come in... And we went to this place and made an audition, and the man was crazy about the band. Oh Lord, was he crazy about 'em. Cass Goldstein at the Saratoga Club. He was a big number banker. He said, "This is my place of business. If nobody comes in here, don't worry about it. You'll get paid just the same." Well, you know, ha-ha, "That sounds awful good, but how can you do it if nobody comes in." He says, "Let me worry about that."…
